description: Test suite for preferences API in Mattermost server, including CRUD operations, sidebar preferences, and websocket event handling.

methods.name: TestGetPreferences
methods.description: Tests retrieving user preferences, including permission checks and admin access.

methods.name: TestGetPreferencesByCategory
methods.description: Tests retrieving preferences filtered by category, including error handling.

methods.name: TestGetPreferenceByCategoryAndName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific preference by category and name, including error cases.

methods.name: TestUpdatePreferences
methods.description: Tests updating user preferences with permission and validation checks.

methods.name: TestUpdatePreferencesOverload
methods.description: Tests validation for empty or too many preferences during update.

methods.name: TestUpdatePreferencesWebsocket
methods.description: Verifies websocket event emission on preferences update.

methods.name: TestUpdateSidebarPreferences
methods.description: Tests sidebar category updates when favoriting/unfavoriting channels and DMs.

methods.name: TestDeletePreferences
methods.description: Tests deleting preferences with permission and validation checks.

methods.name: TestDeletePreferencesOverload
methods.description: Tests validation for empty or too many preferences during delete.

methods.name: TestDeletePreferencesWebsocket
methods.description: Verifies websocket event emission on preferences deletion.

methods.name: TestDeleteSidebarPreferences
methods.description: Tests sidebar updates when removing favorited preferences.

methods.name: TestUpdateLimitVisibleDMsGMs
methods.description: Tests updating the limit of visible DMs and GMs preferences with validation.
